import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"material\":{\"time_and_material_entry_id\":13,\"name\":\"Wallpaper\",\"description\":\"This Material was used for the upper portion of the wall\",\"uom\":\"sf\",\"quantity\":\"2250.75\",\"material_id\":\"019dac6d-e353-7a89-ab24-3637e2bf17bb\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/materials", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
